snippet.title: BRIGHTFALL | Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
You thought surviving the Plague was an achievement? Think again, lad.
Make it through the darkness - or become a part of it. 

👉 We're happy to announce our new game: #BRIGHTFALL.

Brightfall is a co-op open-world survival roguelite for 1 up to 4 players, set on a cursed Celtic island erased from English maps. Explore, craft, and fight to push back the living darkness before it swallows the world.

But beware - light fades, the monsters grow stronger, and even your friends can fall to madness...

🎯 Wishlist NOW on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2850290/Brightfall/?utm_source=yt&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=trailer0
